listing.name: Snowboard Kids / Snowboard Kids: Recompiled (cdlewis)
listing.summary: Explore Snowboard Kids / Snowboard Kids: Recompiled (cdlewis) and follow the upstream project for requirements, downloads and setup.

steps.title: Keep an existing permitted copy
steps.instruction: If you already have a permitted, prepared Snowboard Kids copy, choose its SnowboardKidsRecompiled.exe game executable and supplied working folder in the existing-installation review. Use your own supported North American ROM in the game’s picker. Saving launch details does not run it; launch separately when ready.

steps.title: Keep updates and data with upstream
steps.instruction: Keep the working copy, original ROM and LocalAppData/SnowboardKidsRecompiled data recoverable. Prepare updates separately through upstream. Portcove does not replace, back up or roll back this external runtime or its user-profile saves and settings.

warnings: Portcove downloads are paused until permission for the linked frontend fork is established. Keep using a permitted existing copy; reconsider when upstream provides an attributable compatible grant or replacement.
